newsitem.title: CHINA: S.Korea embassy in China says housing Northern defectors.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea embassy in China says housing Northern defectors.

text.p: South Korea's embassy in China is housing a senior North Korean official and his assistant while they seek asylum, an embassy official said on Wednesday.

"This morning Mr Hwang Jang-yop and his secretary visited our consular section and expressed that they would like to defect to Korea," Chang Moon Ik, the South Korean embassy spokesman, told reporters.
"We are now protecting them in our compound," Chang said.

Hwang is one of 11 secretaries on the powerful secretariat of the Workers' Party that rules Seoul's arch-rival North Korea. The secretariat includes Kim Jong-il, the son and political heir of North Korean founder Kim Il-sung who died in July 1994.
"We also informed the Chinese government of this matter and are negotiating with the Chinese government," Chang said but gave no further details.
Seoul was trying to resolve the matter through diplomatic channels, a South Korean Foreign Ministry official said in Seoul.
Hwang is the most senior North Korean official to seek asylum in the capitalist South.
A string of officials from the impoverished North have defected to South Korea in recent years, including diplomats and air force pilots.
